text: Agreed. What I can see: the advice and API-manager blocks had no age and kept showing the engine's last view even when it wasn't running. Now they say 'as of 6m ago' and '(engine not running)'. Next I'll make the advice smarter (e.g. no 'buy more' for The Odds API when the engine's own pacing already makes the credits last to the reset; that card used one day's pace). Ships with the next release.
